skill.name: umbraco-property-action
skill.description: Implement property actions in Umbraco backoffice using official docs

generated_query: I'm working on an Umbraco CMS project and need to add a small utility button next to the TextBox and TextArea property editors in the backoffice. The button should appear to the right of the property label and, when clicked, clear the current value of that field. Could you help me set up the necessary extension manifest and the action class for this? I'd like it to work for all TextBox and TextArea fields across the CMS. Also, please include instructions on where to place the files and how to test it.
